# Synthetic source tree for scripts/test_import_dag_contract.py.
#
# WHY A MANIFEST AND NOT REAL `.lean` FILES ON DISK:
# `scripts/test_audit_gate.py::CheckedFilesTest` pins the invariant that every
# *tracked* `.lean` file lives under `IsingModel/`, `IsingModel.lean`, `test/`
# or `scripts/audit/`.  Committing fixture `.lean` files under
# `scripts/testdata/` would turn that gate red on merge, and making them
# untracked would make the suite depend on a developer's ignore rules.  The
# fixture therefore ships as text and the test materialises it into a temporary
# directory, which also keeps the whole tree readable in one place.
#
# THE TREE.  One module per layer plus a sink per layer, so that every mutation
# the test applies points at a sink and therefore introduces no import cycle.
# Every edge below is an ALLOWED direction, so the unmutated tree must pass with
# an empty baseline; the single INFO edge is `Inequalities.Capstone ->
# Concrete.Sink` (L2_THEORY -> L4_LATTICE, unranked).
#
# Format: `--- <repo-relative path>` starts a file; everything up to the next
# `---` header is its content.  Lines before the first header are this comment.

--- IsingModel.lean
import IsingModel.TransferMatrix.Chain
import IsingModel.Concrete.Lattice
import IsingModel.Inequalities.Capstone

/-!
# Root umbrella (aggregator: imports only, no declaration).
-/

--- IsingModel/Analysis/Sink.lean
/-! L0_MATH sink: the target of the R1 canary mutation. -/

theorem analysisSink : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/Analysis/Helper.lean
import IsingModel.Analysis.Sink

/-! L0_MATH -> L0_MATH, allowed. -/

theorem analysisHelper : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/Combinatorics/Sink.lean
/-! A second L0_MATH module, so the layer is not a singleton. -/

theorem combinatoricsSink : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/RealTanhAux.lean
/-! L1_MODEL by the exact-module list, importing nothing. -/

theorem realTanhAux : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/Basic.lean
import IsingModel.Analysis.Helper

/-! L1_MODEL -> L0_MATH, allowed. -/

theorem basic : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/Hamiltonian.lean
import IsingModel.Basic

/-! L1_MODEL -> L1_MODEL, allowed.  Source of the R2 canary mutation. -/

theorem hamiltonian : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/Inequalities/Sink.lean
/-! L2_THEORY sink: the target of the R2 canary mutation. -/

theorem inequalitiesSink : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/Inequalities/Theory.lean
import IsingModel.Hamiltonian
import IsingModel.Analysis.Helper
import IsingModel.Inequalities.Sink

/-! L2_THEORY -> L1_MODEL / L0_MATH / L2_THEORY, all allowed. -/

theorem inequalitiesTheory : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/Inequalities/Umbrella.lean
import IsingModel.Inequalities.Theory

/-!
# A compatibility umbrella (aggregator) that re-exports L2_THEORY only.
Importing it from L3_AMBIENT must stay legal; the pass-through test mutates it
to re-export an L4_LATTICE module and then the same import must be flagged.
-/

--- IsingModel/Inequalities/Capstone.lean
import IsingModel.Concrete.Sink

/-! The single INFO edge: L2_THEORY -> L4_LATTICE, unranked and never a failure. -/

theorem inequalitiesCapstone : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/AmbientLattice/Sink.lean
/-! L3_AMBIENT sink. -/

theorem ambientLatticeSink : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/AmbientLattice/Ambient.lean
import IsingModel.Inequalities.Umbrella
import IsingModel.AmbientLattice.Sink

/-! L3_AMBIENT -> L2_THEORY (through an umbrella) and -> L3_AMBIENT, allowed.
Source of the R3 canary mutation. -/

theorem ambientLatticeAmbient : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/AmbientLattice.lean
import IsingModel.AmbientLattice.Ambient

/-!
# The L3_AMBIENT re-export umbrella (aggregator).
-/

--- IsingModel/Concrete/Sink.lean
/-! L4_LATTICE sink: the target of the R1 and R3 canary mutations. -/

theorem concreteSink : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/Concrete/Lattice.lean
import IsingModel.AmbientLattice
import IsingModel.Concrete.Sink

/-! L4_LATTICE -> L3_AMBIENT (through an umbrella) and -> L4_LATTICE, allowed.
Source of the R6 canary mutation. -/

theorem concreteLattice : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/TransferMatrix/Sink.lean
/-! L5_CHAIN sink: the target of the R6 canary mutation. -/

theorem transferMatrixSink : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/TransferMatrix/Chain.lean
import IsingModel.Concrete.Lattice
import IsingModel.TransferMatrix.Sink

/-! L5_CHAIN -> L4_LATTICE and -> L5_CHAIN, allowed. -/

theorem transferMatrixChain : True := trivial
